- Broncos -10, Lions -6.5, Chiefs -16.5, Jaguars -6, Panthers -2.5, Chargers -3.5: models at the number or split.
- MNF Bengals -6.5 at Commanders: Covers AI CIN by 3, SBR by 10. Split; revisit Monday.
